result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The verse directly presents Uzziah’s abundant livestock as the reason he dug many cisterns. The following statement about loving the soil explains his farmers and vinedressers, not the cisterns, so it is not a materially different answer. The edit changes the prepared answer target from his love of farming to his livestock, even though the original source answer mentioned both ideas.
